page.overview:
Who is Edashi?

When a wild boar began to come to the gardens of the inhabitants of the country and spoil the harvest, Taizō gathered friends and offered to hunt him down. Although Gasuka remarked that it was dangerous, Taizō assured him that Asura would protect them with Ninshū, who agreed, and Edashi talked about the animal ruining the gardens. After some time, they managed to reach the boar, which pursued Asura and killed Shiro who was protecting him. Edashi and the others hid in a tree while Asura was rescued by his brother Indra.

Many years later, as adults, Edashi and Gasuka came to Taizō, who was hiding in a hut on a hill, and informed him that Hagoromo sent Asura on a mission to another village. When Asura was appointed as Hagoromo's successor, Edashi attended the party, after helping to fight Indra, who was unhappy with his father's choice.

Edashi was an adventurer as a child, as he did not hesitate to follow his friends after the boar. As an adult, Edashi showed concern for Asura by informing Taizō of his departure from the village.

Edashi was a guy of medium height with short black hair, black eyes, and a slight stubble on his face. He wears grey pants, a beige t-shirt, and a long sleeveless lilac cloak, and Edashi didn't wear any sandals or boots.
